name: J11
note: Beauty-only look (scripts/aircraft_look.py). Lights sit on the body mesh's measured extremes (wingtips at -y/+y, tail at -x), nudged inward by offset_m (actor metres) so the bulb touches the skin; every class parameter not stated here is the master default; every number here is UNCALIBRATED: set by probe render on the render machine. The J-11's MTL names are not measured on this machine (its source is fetched at import, not here), so it has no slot_rules: glass and rubber come from the automatic rules. Matte PLAAF grey: low clear coat. The landing lamp sits on the nose gear: assets/aircraft_config/J11.json keypoints_note measures the mesh's nose gear at x 7.5..8.2 m aft of the nose (7.85 m used); the 1.5 m drop below the nose tip is an estimate. Nozzles: the FDM's two AL-31F thruster lines (J11.xml, y +-20 in), x snapped to the mesh; the afterburner follows the engine file's milthrust/maxthrust.
